commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
if [ -e /etc/pki/fleet-ca ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Refusing to overwrite existing /etc/pki/fleet-ca' >&2
  exit 1
fi
install -d -m 0700 /etc/pki/fleet-ca/private /etc/pki/fleet-ca/certs /etc/pki/fleet-ca/newcerts
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out /etc/pki/fleet-ca/private/fleet-internal-ca.key
openssl req -x509 -new -sha256 -days 3650 -key /etc/pki/fleet-ca/private/fleet-internal-ca.key -out /etc/pki/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt -subj '/CN=Fleet Internal CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash'
chmod 0600 /etc/pki/fleet-ca/private/fleet-internal-ca.key
chmod 0644 /etc/pki/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt
install -m 0644 /etc/pki/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/fleet-internal-ca.crt
update-ca-trust
openssl x509 -in /etc/pki/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt /etc/pki/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/pki/fleet-ca/private/fleet-internal-ca.key /etc/pki/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/fleet-internal-ca.crt

set -eu
umask 077
if [ -e /etc/pki/fleet-tls ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Refusing to overwrite existing /etc/pki/fleet-tls' >&2
  exit 1
fi
install -d -m 0750 /etc/pki/fleet-tls/private /etc/pki/fleet-tls/certs
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out /etc/pki/fleet-tls/private/node2.key
openssl req -new -sha256 -key /etc/pki/fleet-tls/private/node2.key -out /tmp/node2.csr -subj '/CN=node2' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:node2,IP:'"$NODE_IP" -addext 'keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment' -addext 'extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth'
chmod 0600 /etc/pki/fleet-tls/private/node2.key
openssl req -in /tmp/node2.csr -noout -subject -verify
printf '%s\n' 'CSR_BASE64_BEGIN'
base64 -w0 /tmp/node2.csr
printf '\n%s\n' 'CSR_BASE64_END'
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/pki/fleet-tls/private/node2.key

set -eu
printf '%s' '[REDACTED_ENCODED_BLOB]' | base64 -d > /tmp/node2.csr
openssl req -in /tmp/node2.csr -noout -verify -subject
cat > /tmp/node2-ext.cnf <<'FLEET_EOF'
basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE
keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth
subjectAltName=DNS:node2,IP:10.100.205.11
subjectKeyIdentifier=hash
authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid,issuer
FLEET_EOF
openssl x509 -req -sha256 -days 825 -in /tmp/node2.csr -CA /etc/pki/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt -CAkey /etc/pki/fleet-ca/private/fleet-internal-ca.key -CAcreateserial -out /etc/pki/fleet-ca/newcerts/node2.crt -extfile /tmp/node2-ext.cnf
